messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a hole in the token-level latency breakdown for /v1/generate starting ~2024-11-03T14:05Z after the kernel-selector rollout. Dashboard shows missing p50/p95 series for token_latency.tokenized.* for ~14:05-14:20. :thinking_face:

maya: Can you paste the grafana panel link? I want to see per-route.

alex: https://grafana.internal/r/alpha/token-latency?orgId=1&from=1700000700000&to=1700000820000
The panel for route=/v1/generate is blank for token-level series; aggregate latency still present.

ops-bot: Alert: statsd_exporter_dropped_metrics increased by 1.2k for host inference-03 in window 14:04-14:18 (rule: statsd-drop-spike).

jordan: Quick triage idea: is this a tag/label change in the kernel rollout? If token labels changed (e.g., kernel=quant->quantv2) the StatsD keys might not match the dashboard queries.

sanjay: Checked exporter logs on inference-03 at 14:06: `ERROR: metric write failed: unexpected tag format: "kernel:quantv2"` — looks like our statsd->otlp mapper rejected tags with colon. We recently merged a kernel selector that annotates every token metric with kernel:<name>.

maya: Ugh. So the metrics were being dropped at the exporter, not lost upstream. That explains blank series while p90 host-level still shows.

alex: Any quick fix? We need token-level breakdowns for the canary rollback decision.

sanjay: Short patch: map `kernel:` prefixed tags to `kernel=` before shipping. I'll roll a hotfix to statsd-mapper service in staging, then prod if green. ETA ~20m.

lia: Also, because of the mapper drop, our backfill job will need to re-ingest raw statsd files from 14:04-14:20. I can kick a backfill once the hotfix is live. Backfill job id will be bf-20241103-179876. It replays batched snapshots into the metrics pipeline.

jordan: Hypothesis on perf regression: kernel-selector changed batching heuristics which increased prefix miss rate on the KV cache. That caused extra per-token work and we annotated kernel to debug. The annotation change unintentionally broke the exporter. Two issues collided. We should add an integration test: verify label format roundtrips through statsd->otlp.

maya: Agree. Action items: 1) sanjay hotfix statsd-mapper (inflight) 2) lia run backfill bf-20241103-179876 (post-hotfix) 3) alex add dashboard alias to include both kernel tag formats so historical panels don't go blank 4) jordan add unit/integration test for mapper tag formats.

alex: I'll also add a short note to the rollout playbook to avoid adding new colon-prefixed tags without an exporter update.

sanjay: Hotfix deployed to prod at 14:28, mapper logs show no more `unexpected tag format` errors.

lia: Starting backfill bf-20241103-179876 at 14:30. Will post progress every 5m.

ops-bot: Backfill job bf-20241103-179876 status: running (replaying 960 snapshots, est 12m).

maya: After ~14:38 the token-level panels start populating. Looks like backfill is working. Check p50/p95 on route=/v1/generate for regressions.

alex: Verified: token breakdowns present for 14:05-14:20 now. No immediate perf regression visible in token latency median; p95 slightly higher by ~4ms during 14:06-14:12 — correlates with kernel rollout window.

jordan: We should keep an eye on KV cache hit histograms for the next 24h; if hit rate drops >3% we revert the batching heuristic change.

maya: I'll create a short dashboard alert and add the mapper tag-format test to the CI matrix.

alex: Thanks everyone. Closing thread when backfill completes and we confirm no further drops.

ops-bot: Backfill job bf-20241103-179876 completed at 14:42, status: success (replayed 960 snapshots).
